messages:
Max: heads up — onboarding a new hf/chat_template model (from community) and our evals show a subtle but consistent quality regression after conversion + int8 quant. suspecting prompt formatting mismatch.
Tara: can you paste the original chat_template? quick glance might show missing sentinel or role tokens.
Max: gist of template: 
```jinja
{% raw %}{% if system %}{{ system }}
{% endif %}{% for m in messages %}{{ m.role }}: {{ m.content }}
{% endfor %}{% endraw %}```
Max: conversion script produced a single concatenated prompt with role prefixes like `System:` / `User:` but we didn't preserve the sentinel markers hf was adding (`<|eos|>` style) or inject special tokens into tokenizer.
Oliver: ah — many hf chat templates rely on special sentinel tokens (or BOS/EOS placement) so tokenization + kv cache alignment changes. int8 can amplify tiny distribution shifts and fail evals. :thinking_face:
Sasha: do we have the model's config.json? sometimes `tokenizer_class` or `bos_token` flags differ.
Max: config has: 
```json
{"model_type": "llama", "tokenizer_class": "LlamaTokenizer", "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "add_eos_token": true}
```
Max: but tokenizer has extra added tokens used by the chat_template: `['<|system|>', '<|user|>', '<|assistant|>']` — the conversion didn't call `tokenizer.add_tokens` for them.
Tara: so during conversion we flattened roles to `System:` text tokens instead of ensuring those sentinel tokens exist in token vocab. That will change token boundaries for early context.
Oliver: suggestion: update conversion to a) preserve role sentinel tokens from the HF template, b) call tokenizer.add_tokens for any non-empty `added_tokens`, and c) map them to consistent sentinel ids before building KV cache offsets.
Sasha: also watch ordering: HF chat_template sometimes expects `system` first even if empty block allowed. Our renderer dropped empty `system` block, shifting every message by one role. That matches the regression pattern (answers shifted for many prompts).
Max: repro steps I used: run HF template -> convert -> run Redwood runtime w/ int8 quant -> run eval set (1000 prompts) -> BLEU/ROUGE drop ~4-6%.
Tara: can you share a failing example (orig vs converted tokenization)? short would help.
Max: example: 
Original rendered tokens (showing tokenized strings):
```
['<|system|>', 'You', 'are', 'a', 'helpful', 'assistant', '<|assistant|>', '<|user|>', 'How', 'are', 'you', '?']
```
Converted tokens (our pipeline):
```
['System', ':', 'You', 'are', 'a', 'helpful', 'assistant', 'User', ':', 'How', 'are', 'you', '?']
```
Max: you can see the sentinel ids vs plain words — length and token splits differ.
Oliver: yep. tokenizer.add_tokens will create new ids but beware of `resize_token_embeddings` if the model head depends on vocab size. For int8 eval, we need model embedding shapes consistent with added tokens.
Sasha: good catch. also check that `config.quantize` or our quant pipeline doesn't fold prompt-related special tokens into calibration tables incorrectly. Calib with missing sentinels will misalign scales.
Tara: short-term patch: when conversion sees `chat_template` with role blocks, insert explicit sentinel tokens into the rendered template and call tokenizer.add_special_tokens({ 'additional_special_tokens': [...] }) before tokenizing. Then re-run the eval.
ci-bot: deploy note — conversion script updated in branch `hf-chat-fixes` (PR #1182) to preserve `added_tokens` and keep empty system blocks as optional sentinel. CI: unit tests added for token-preserve and a small quantization smoke test.
Max: testing branch now. initial smoke shows BLEU gap narrowed to ~0.8% before full eval. will report after 1k-run.
Oliver: once that's green, we should add an onboarding checklist item: "preserve HF special tokens + ensure tokenizer/model embedding resize". saves future surprises. :memo:
Sasha: and add a tiny test harness that compares tokenized sequences orig vs converted for 50 random templates. if divergence > threshold, fail onboarding.
Tara: agreed. thanks for catching this early, Max.
Max: thanks team — pinging @Sasha to own the tokenizer add flow, @Oliver to coordinate embedding resize checks, and I'll run the full eval when tests pass. :thumbsup:
